correctness.operation: out-of-place contiguous row-major FP32 transpose: B[col*rows+row]=A[row*cols+col]
correctness.comparison: retained CPU checker records report full bitwise final payload, finite counts and both 32-word guards; this projection rereads metadata, not tensors
correctness.input_scope: one deterministic position-unique float32 input; repeated checks are not independent random inputs

measurement.timed_scope: default-stream events around 10 launches; may include device idle gaps during host submission
measurement.cache_policy: repeated addresses; no explicit application cache reset; runtime cache policy unknown
measurement.transfer_scope: allocation, initialization, transfers and file writes outside event intervals
measurement.throughput_scope: logical read+write bytes; not measured DRAM traffic
measurement.function_attribute_query: before each case's warmups and timing; runtime observations, not occupancy measurements
measurement.wave_size_note: MACA 3.5.3 headers alias waveSize to warpSize; one API observation
measurement.control: one non-template dynamic-shared kernel; A=(pitch64,16384 requested bytes), B=(pitch64,16640), C=(pitch65,16640)
measurement.analysis_unit: process; each case uses its ten-batch median, T_A=(T_A_first+T_A_last)/2; summarize ten process ratios with median[min,max] and all values
measurement.balance: five cyclic shape rotations each repeated with A_first,B,C,A_last and A_first,C,B,A_last; no complete carryover balance claim
measurement.device_buffers: same input/output device allocations reused inside each process

plan.question: Effect of launch dynamic-shared request at fixed pitch, and pitch at fixed request, in one kernel

estimands.request: T_A / T_B, where T_A is arithmetic mean of the two endpoint case batch medians
estimands.drift: T_A_first / T_A_last; also retain each endpoint divided by B

plan.acceptance: All final payload and guard checks pass; retain every process with no drift-based exclusion or timing threshold. Device errors stop the stage and retain evidence.
limitations: Endpoint averaging does not eliminate nonlinear drift or carryover
No capacity-pitch interaction estimate; C at16384 would be invalid

artifacts.public_projection: all 260 cases and 2600 event/host timing batches; complete case check counts, per-process endpoint ratios, trace resources/durations/recompile flags and cache file counts; tensors and private process/path metadata remain outside source

limitations: Requested dynamic shared bytes, function static sharedSizeBytes/maxDynamicSharedSizeBytes, and trace descriptors have separate meanings; none alone reports physical per-launch allocation or actual occupancy.
Endpoint averaging does not eliminate nonlinear drift or carryover; every accepted process and both endpoint ratios are retained.
The pitch control changes active shared addresses/span; no per-instruction address trace or C550 bank-conflict mechanism was established.
The unsafe pitch65/16384 pair is excluded; this three-condition study does not estimate a full capacity-pitch interaction.
Runtime cache policy, fixed frequency and system-wide isolation are not established by these timing records.
Trace durations retain their reported units and no conversion is inferred; profiled timings stay separate from unprofiled confirmation.
One card/software stack, deterministic FP32 input and bounded shapes; no cross-study absolute-latency causal claim or framework qualification.
